name: Roy McNamara
source:
Roy is the Lead detective of your team. He has been on the case since it was first discovered. He’s a depressed nihilist but he’s also a genius, he’s extremely good at his job but has a drinking problem. He lost his old team to a new upstart detective, because they are taking Roy off this case soon. This is your last chance to solve this before Roy and your whole team are put behind desks. Roy has the most comprehensive knowledge of the case as a whole. (Fun fact: He has an Irish accent)
